title: Baobab Platform Relationship and Platform Account Contracts (ADR-BCP-018)
description:
Definition library for PlatformRelationship, PlatformAccount and PlatformAccountMembership.
Validate resources against fragment URIs (e.g. #/$defs/PlatformRelationship), not the document root.

An Organisation may hold concurrent PlatformRelationships (e.g. PLATFORM_PARTNER + EXTERNAL_CLIENT). Privileged types (PLATFORM_OWNER, PLATFORM_OPERATOR, PLATFORM_GROUP_AFFILIATE) are server-authoritative and never self-assigned.

Invariants (ADR-BCP-018):
  PlatformRelationship != ProductSubscription, != runtime authorization
  PLATFORM_GROUP_AFFILIATE != runtime permission
  PlatformAccount != Tenant, != CorporateGroup, != authorization boundary
  same PlatformAccount != shared tenant access

platformRelationshipType.description: Durable relationship between an Organisation and the Baobab Platform (ADR-BCP-018 section 32). Extensible by a versioned contract change.

platformAccountRole.description: Commercial/administrative role within a PlatformAccount (ADR-BCP-018 section 43). Never a runtime permission or IAM role.

PlatformRelationship.description: Carries no runtime authorization. PLATFORM_GROUP_AFFILIATE must preserve the CorporateRelationship that justifies it (ADR-BCP-018 section 118).

basis_relationship_id.description: CorporateRelationship that justifies group-derived relationship types.

admission_decision_id.description: Admission decision (ADR-BCP-017 / ADR-BCP-023) that authorised this platform relationship.

source_authority.description: Server-side authority for PLATFORM_OWNER, PLATFORM_OPERATOR and PLATFORM_GROUP_AFFILIATE; applicants cannot self-classify as first-party (ADR-BCP-018 section 70).

verified_by.description: Authenticated principal or governed process that performed verification. Server-derived; never accepted from a client payload.

PlatformAccount.description: Commercial, contractual and administrative grouping (ADR-BCP-018 section 41). Not a legal identity, corporate ownership, tenant or authorization boundary. Organisations participate only through explicit PlatformAccountMemberships.

contract_references.description: Opaque references to master service or commercial agreements.

billing_profile_reference.description: Opaque billing-profile reference. Never payment credentials.

PlatformAccountMembership.description: Effective-dated participation of an Organisation in a PlatformAccount (ADR-BCP-018 section 43). Account roles are commercial and never runtime permissions. Tenant bindings to an account are a separate, explicit concept and are not expressed here.
